name: nginx-multisite
description: Configures Nginx for three named virtual hosts with static content, HTTPS redirection, self-signed TLS certificates, security headers, rate limiting, Fail2ban, UFW, SSH hardening, and kernel network hardening.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis, including Redis authentication, logging, service enablement, and post-install configuration.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Installs Python and PostgreSQL prerequisites, deploys the FastAPI application from GitHub, configures its virtual environment and database, writes environment settings, and runs Uvicorn as a systemd service.
